name: PDS P-001: a failed drill run names the failing phase and reason, and carries the adapter stderr tail with its full path (live same-box runs, 2026-09-30)
falsifier: A physical failure whose summary line is only the generic 'physical E/G adapter command failed', names a trailer line (such as the EXIT trap's 'preserved failed-run diagnostics') instead of the cause, or whose log omits the adapter stderr tail.
note: Both runs are real, unplanned failures of the physical scenario, driven through the drill's single entry point (hive-git-drill.sh -> hive-git-physical-probe.sh -> hive-git-physical-scenario.sh) against the same-box rig (D-003/D-005: diagnostic, never release evidence). In both, the EXIT trap's trailer line ('preserved failed-run diagnostics') is the LAST stderr line, and the summary names the real cause printed before it, which is exactly the falsifier's trap. Each run kept its own evidence directory (R-2).
